language: "Urdu"

1
Manam Ghulam e Hazrat e Shah e Najaf Mir Hasan Mir.
Qalb-e-Man Ali Ali Ali Ali.
Roh-e-Man Ali Ali Ali Ali.
Jan-e-Man Ali Ali Ali Ali.
Molana Ali Ali, Molana Ali Ali.
Dil Khicha Jata Hai Har Bar Mera Unn Ki Taraf.
Manam Ghulam-e-Hazrat-e-Shah-e-Najaf.
Izn-e-Mabood Se Konain Chalata Hai Ali.
Raat Ki Neend Se Soraj Ko Jagata Hai Ali.
Dars-e-Tauheed Farishton Ko Sikhata Hai Ali.
Do Jahan Mein Jahan Dekho Nazar Aata Hai Ali.
Tasbeehum Ali Ali.
Taqreerum Ali Ali.
Taqderum Ali Ali.
Ali Mola, Ali Mola, Ali Maula.
Mere Seene Mein Hai Bajti Yehi Nobat Yehi Daf.
Phir Sunein Gay Ossi Andaz Mein Haider Haider.
Sahib Ul-Asr Ki Aawaz Mein Haider Haider.
Aasmano Se Yeh Esa Ki Sada Aati Hai.
Ho Naye Saal Ke Aagaz Mein Haider Haider.
Mere Lab Par Ho Ali Ali.
Har Ik Ghar Ghar Ho Ali Ali.
Bas Ab Khul Kar Ho Ali Ali.
Ali Mola, Ali Mola, Ali Maula.
Ik Taraf Sara Zamana Hai Ali Aik Taraf.
Daman Ko Aansoon Se Bhigoye Ga Saal Bhar.
Apne Gunah Kandhoon Pe Dhoye Ga Saal Bhar.
Terah Rajab Jo Kabay Ki Sorat Nahi Hansa.
Aray Woh Aadmi Naseeb Ko Roye Ga Saal Bhar.
Kehti Hai Kabay Ki Dewar Basad Izz-o-Sharf.
Dil Ali, Dilbar Ali, Sarwar Ali, Rah Ali, Rehbar Ali, Mehshar Ali.
Jan Ali, Janan Ali, Eman Ali.
Rooh Ali, Reham Ali, Rizwan Ali.
ALLAH ALLAH ALLAH.
Dil Ke Har Saaz Ki Dharkan Mein Ali Rehta Hai.
Meri Aawaz Mere Man Mein Ali Rehta Hai.
Bhairavi Mein Mere Ayeman Mein Ali Rehta Hai.
Dil Ki Dhamal Ki Jhan Jhan Mein Ali Rehta Hai.
Irfanum Ali Ali, Quranam Ali Ali, Emanam Ali Ali.
Ali Mola, Ali Mola, Ali Maula.
Aik Hi Dar Pe Sada Rehta Hoon Kashkool Bakaf.
Meri Izzat Meri Dastar Bhi Ishq-e-Haider.
Meri Khamoshi Bhi Guftar Bhi Ishq-e-Haider.
Hai Meri Dhaal Bhi Talwar Bhi Ishq-e-Haider.
Dosti Ka Meri Maiyar Bhi Ishq-e-Haider.
Janat Mein Ali Ali, Turbat Mein Ali Ali, Sangat Mein Ali Ali.
Ali Mola, Ali Mola, Ali Maula.
Dushman-e-Fatima Zahra Hai Faqat Mera Hadaf.
Haq Ka Irfan Jo Paya Tu Ali Yaad Aaya.
Dil Mein Quran Samaya Tu Ali Yaad Aaya.
Apne Ghar Se Main Chala Kar Ke Iradah Hajj Ka.
Thi Yeh Niyat Ke Karon Ga Main Tawaf-e-Kaba.
Kaba Jab Samne Aaya Tu Ali Yaad Aaya.
Aik Hi Dur Hai Ali Jis Ka Yeh Kaba Hai Sadaf.
Ali Ali Ali.
Meri Parwaz Se Kotah Nazar Jaltay Hain.
Loag Kuch Kar Nahi Saktay Hain Magar Kartay Hain.
Ya Ali Keh Ke Wahan Se Main Guzar Jata Hoon.
Jahan Jate Hoye Jibreel Ke Par Jaltay Hain.
Danai Ali Ali, Sachai Ali Ali, Darayi Ali Ali.
Badshahon Ko Bhi Hasil Nahi Hota Yeh Sharf.
Wahan Qadam Ka Hai Kya Kam Aye Adab Toba.
Saron Se Chalne Ke Qabil Hain Kocha Haye Najaf.
Mili Yeh Angothi Bhi Wesi Hi Tha Nageen Jaisa.
Najaf Bara-e-Ali Tha Ali Bara-e-Najaf.
Idhar Se Koshish e Kamil Hai Our Udhar Se Kashish.
 Anees Hum Na Rahein Gay Kahin Siwaye Najaf.
Lafz-o-Mani Hain Na Abjad Hai Ali Se Aagay.
Koi Manzil Hai Na Maqsad Hai Ali Se Aagay.
Shehar-e-Tauheed Ki Sarhad Hai Ali Se Aagay.
Sirf Bandon Mein Muhammad Hai Ali Se Aagay.
Taroon Mein Ali Ali.
Paroon Mein Ali Ali.
Yaroon Mein Ali Ali.
Zikar-e-Haider Hi Takallum Hai Zabaan Ka Masraf.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 75 verses in Urdu script and verified that they align line by line with the original transcription in `romanLyrics`. Updated the title and right-to-left metadata and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag.

I retained “Mir Hasan Mir” in the opening line as transcribed. Ambiguous readings include “Ayeman” as ایمن, “Darayi” as دارائی, and “Dur” as دُر.
